dct_description_sm:
The DRAPE 2024 imagery acquisition was sponsored by Geospatial Ontario, Government of Ontario, and the Government of Canada.
 

The imagery products described in this metadata record are open data. Use of any imagery indicates your acceptance of the Open Government Licence – Ontario.
 

For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: March 12th - May 31st 2024
  • Number of Frames: 32,545 frames
  • Canopy Coverage: Leaf-Off/Low-Leaf
  • Resolution: 16 centimetre
  • Bit-depth: 8-bit
  • Number of Image bands: Four band (RGBN)
  • Format: TIFF (ISAT AT model setup)
  • Camera(s): Vexcel UltraCam Eagle frame-based

For more information on the Digital Raster Acquisition Project Eastern Ontario (DRAPE) 2024 please see the main DRAPE 2024 GeoHub record.
